evidence.quote: Backend and model coverage remain limited.
This supports cross-harness portability but does not establish broad plug-and-play generality across arbitrary harness/model pairs.
it is less suitable for one-off subjective tasks, highly nonstationary environments, or failures caused by unavailable tools or data
Full online evolution can be order-sensitive under sparse evidence
Future work includes richer Bayesian decision policies, broader adapters, and transfer of skill beliefs across models and deployments.
The default backend is a factorized categorical evidence model with Laplace smoothing rather than full Bayesian structure learning or model selection.
The native Bayesian rows spend more tokens, so the evidence supports stronger task completion under sparse evidence rather than lower cost.
